title.narrative: Citywide PPP Led Integrated Fecal Sludge and Solid Waste Management

description.narrative: The project is a citywide public private partnership (PPP) led Integrated Fecal Sludge and Solid Waste Management for improving water security and inclusive green growth in Satkhira and Gaibandha municipalities in Bangladesh. The project will be serving 300,000 people, focusing specific needs of women and children, the reduction of water pollution and logging, waste treatment and end product market development, focusing employment, increased income and decent working environments for informal waste and sanitation workers. The main project approach includes integrated planning, multi-stakeholder engaged PPP led inclusive business model development, comprehensive social mobilization for awareness raising of consumer communities to participate in doorstep waste and sludge collection services, design and construction of physical infrastructures for recycling of waste to biogas and organic fertilizer, building local capacity for sustainable operations and maintenance (O&M), women economic empowerment from value chain development and market promotion of recycled products, dignifying and decent working environment for social inclusion of waste and sanitation workers, ICT based monitoring for tracking consumers satisfaction. The key project partners include the municipalities, Private sector and consumer communities. The business is expected to reach breakeven in the fourth year and envisages subsidy from municipality to minimize the gap for breakeven. Practical Action, Natural Synergies (NS), CapitaLand Development Limited (CDL) and WASTE Netherlands will provide technical assistances in local capacity building, advanced researches and supporting the development of national operational plans which will facilitate the knowledge sharing and scaling up PPP led inclusive business model in collaboration with national programmes on waste management.
